findings.detail: D06 continuity is artificially low because issuer identity is not being keyed to the raw Issuer cell; the source schedule shows repeated issuers across March 31, 2026 and December 31, 2025.

rationale: D06 reports only 16 of 231 issuers persisting, but raw source schedule pages show repeated issuer/instrument rows between the March 31, 2026 schedule and the December 31, 2025 comparative schedule. ALCV Purchaser, Inc. (AutoLenders) appears in both table 11 row 4 and table 18 row 4, and PMA Parent Holdings, LLC appears in both table 11 row 16 and table 18 row 17. This supports an extraction/keying defect in issuer continuity rather than true portfolio discontinuity.
